svg.title: Shared by all options — alarm severity, emulator banner, widget classes
svg.text: Shared by all options — alarm severity, emulator banner, widget classes
1 How a value shows its EPICS alarm severity (same rule for fields, synoptic tags, table rows, lamps)
INVALID (device silent, record cannot be trusted): the number is replaced by the word INVALID; the last good value and its time are one click away (expert).
Disconnected (no Channel Access connection, IOC down): RAS already replaces the value by the PV name and a disconnect icon; we show ‘no connection’ and grey it out.
Colour is never the only carrier: the marker (▲ ■ ? ×) and the word keep it readable in grayscale and for colour-blind readers. No thresholds are coded in pages.
2 Emulator banner (on every page, below the app bar)
EMULATOR — rack IOC and HV IOC report mode sim. No hardware is connected.
MIXED — rack IOC in mode sim, HV IOC on real hardware. Platform values are real.
Blue diagonal stripes: a colour no alarm uses. Mode comes from each IOC’s mode PV, not from a GUI setting. Mode unknown (PV disconnected) shows the banner too. Window title gets the prefix ‘[SIM]’.
3 Widget classes (one React component each, PV names from the registry)
one class, unit and format from the PV
s1 s2 s3 s4 s5 s6 s7 s8

Plus: Trend (RAS GraphY with time stamps), synoptic symbols (electrode, valve, gauge, pump, cup) and the value tag. Placeholders in the app bar: PDF report (WP8); loops (WP10) get their own widget class later.
